title.narrative: Support to Lebanon Social Safety Net

description.narrative:
Overall objective is increased resilience of the most economically vulnerable population in Lebanon. The project seeks to foster Government of Lebanon's capacity to provide lifeline social assistance to the most vulnerable families through tailored capacity strengthening for Government stakeholders and the provision of school meals. Specifically, the support will deliver on the two outcomes below:
Outcome 1: National institutions in Lebanon have increased capacity to manage social safety nets and other programmes by 2025. The government's social safety nets target only vulnerable Lebanese.
Outcome 2: Vulnerable school-age girls and boys in targeted schools receive a daily nutrition-sesnsitive school-meal, contributing to decreasing dropout, increasing attendance, and learning and improving their nutritional intake. This program is for lebanse and syrian children.
Both programmes are gender sensitive and includes women and girls (based on gender analysis). The programs are sensitive to other dimensions of vulnerability such as food security, disability, nutrition and/or categorical (lifecycle approach).
Target group: - Vulnerable and poor Lebanese households that meet the targeting criteria of NPTP (NSSN) - Ministry of Social Affairs and the Government of Lebanon. - 130 000 Lebanese and refugee children aged 5-14 years old receive nutritious school snack or in-school prepared cold meals.
All regions, including Beirut, Mount Lebanon, North Lebanon, South Lebanon and Bekaa areas.
